audit_phase: Phase 5.14.5.2 — Final Terminal Validation & Stale Approval Safety
component: Strict Pytest Terminal Summary Finality Parser (Fix A)

enforced_specifications.summary_position: Terminal non-empty line of stdout (index == len(lines) - 1)
enforced_specifications.summary_uniqueness: Exactly one valid summary line across stdout (len(matched) == 1)
enforced_specifications.exit_code_rule: exit_code == 0 required; non-zero exit code immediately triggers failure
enforced_specifications.trailing_output_rejection: Any non-empty trailing output (tracebacks, errors, prose, warnings) causes immediate failure

adversarial_scenarios_tested.scenario: Post-summary error message ('ERROR: process terminated after summary')
Duplicate identical summary lines ('25 passed in 2.30s' x 2)
Conflicting summary lines ('25 passed in 2.30s' and '20 passed, 5 failed')
Triple summary lines across execution log
Summary line embedded in middle of logging output
Missing or malformed duration ('in s', 'in fast')
Non-zero process exit code with passing summary format
Skipped tests policy violation when allow_skipped=False
Valid complete terminal summary at final line with duration > 0 and exit_code 0
